Presidential Documents
2585 Federal Register / Vol. 90, No. 7 / Monday, January 13, 2025 / Presidential Documents 
Executive Order 14138 of January 3, 2025 
Providing an Order of Succession Within the Office of Man-
agement and Budget 
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the 
laws of the United States of America, including the Federal Vacancies Reform 
Act of 1998, as amended, 5 U.S.C. 3345 et seq. (the ‘‘Act’’), it is hereby 
ordered that:

clauses.label: Section 1.
clauses.text:
Section 1. Order of Succession. Subject to the provisions of section 2 of 
this order, and to the limitations set forth in the Act, the following officials 
of the Office of Management and Budget, in the order listed, shall act 
as and perform the functions and duties of the office of Director of the 
Office of Management and Budget (Director) during any period in which 
both the Director and the Deputy Director of the Office of Management 
and Budget have died, resigned, or otherwise become unable to perform 
the functions and duties of the office of Director:

clauses.label: (a)
clauses.text: (a) Deputy Director for Management;

clauses.label: (b)
clauses.text: (b) Executive Associate Director;

clauses.label: (c)
clauses.text: (c) Associate Director (National Security Programs);

clauses.label: (d)
clauses.text: (d) Associate Director (General Government Programs);

clauses.label: (e)
clauses.text:
(e) Associate Director (Education, Income Maintenance, and Labor Pro-
grams);

clauses.label: (f)
clauses.text: (f) Associate Director (Health Programs);

clauses.label: (g)
clauses.text:
(g) Associate Director (Climate, Energy, Environment, and Science Pro-
grams);

clauses.label: (h)
clauses.text: (h) General Counsel;

clauses.label: (i)
clauses.text: (i) Administrator for Federal Procurement Policy;

clauses.label: (j)
clauses.text: (j) Administrator of the Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs;

clauses.label: (k)
clauses.text: (k) Controller, Office of Federal Financial Management; and

clauses.label: (l)
clauses.text: (l) Administrator of the Office of Electronic Government.

clauses.label: Sec. 2.
clauses.text:
Sec. 2. Exceptions. (a) No individual who is serving in an office listed 
in section 1(a)–(l) of this order in an acting capacity shall, by virtue of 
so serving, act as Director pursuant to this order.

clauses.label: (b)
clauses.text: (b) No individual who is serving in an office listed in section 1(a)–

clauses.label: (l)
clauses.text:
(l) of this order shall act as Director unless that individual is otherwise 
eligible to so serve under the Act.

clauses.label: (c)
clauses.text:
(c) Notwithstanding the provisions of this order, the President retains 
discretion, to the extent permitted by law, to depart from this order in 
designating an acting Director.

clauses.label: Sec. 3.
clauses.text:
Sec. 3. Revocation. Executive Order 13615 of May 21, 2012 (Providing an 
Order of Succession Within the Office of Management and Budget), is hereby 
revoked.

clauses.label: Sec. 4.
clauses.text:
Sec. 4. General Provisions. (a) Nothing in this order shall be construed 
to impair or otherwise affect:

clauses.label: (i)
clauses.text:
(i) the authority granted by law to an executive department or agency, 
or the head thereof; or 
VerDate Sep<11>2014 16:14 Jan 10, 2025 Jkt 265001 PO 00000 Frm 00001 Fmt 4790 Sfmt 4790 E:\FR\FM\13JAE4.SGM 13JAE4ddrumheller on DSK120RN23PROD with PRESDOC-E4
=== PDF page 2 of 2 ===
2586 Federal Register / Vol. 90, No. 7 / Monday, January 13, 2025 / Presidential Documents

clauses.label: (ii)
clauses.text:
(ii) the functions of the Director of the Office of Management and Budget 
relating to budgetary, administrative, or legislative proposals.

clauses.label: (b)
clauses.text:
(b) This order shall be implemented consistent with applicable law and 
subject to the availability of appropriations.

clauses.label: (c)
clauses.text:
(c) This order is not intended to, and does not, create any right or benefit, 
substantive or procedural, enforceable at law or in equity by any party 
against the United States, its departments, agencies, or entities, its officers, 
employees, or agents, or any other person.
